'''DecipherCon 1999 EPP Overdrive''' was a Star Wars CCG sealed side event at [[DecipherCon 1999]] (Cavalier Hotel, Virginia Beach, Virginia). Decipher scheduled it as SW.24 EPP Overdrive on Thursday 11 November from 11 p.m. to 3 a.m. and Saturday 13 November from 5 p.m. to 9 p.m.<ref name="dc99-thu">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/thu_events.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Schedule: Thursday], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20021005063305/http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/thu_events.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="dc99-sat">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/sat_events.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Schedule: Saturday], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001026023004/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/sat_events.html Internet Archive]</ref>

* '''Date:''' 11 November 1999; 13 November 1999
* '''Site:''' Cavalier Hotel, Virginia Beach, Virginia
* '''Format:''' [[EPP Overdrive]]

A score sheet is not preserved.
